shortDescription: Bolivia’s central bank said it will start selling US dollars to financial institutions on Wednesday to support the currency after it fell more than 20% since the country adopted a flexible foreign-exchange regime in late June, according to Bloomberg.

title: Bolivia Central Bank to Begin Dollar Sales to Banks Wednesday
